title: Read supported bank tables without vertical rules
summary: Supported digital bank statements retain transaction columns and source highlights even without a full grid.
bodyMarkdown:
## What changed

Native PDF table extraction supports the Date, Description, Money out, Money in and Balance layout. Empty amounts remain empty and each cell retains its source coordinates.

## Why it matters

Supported bank statements no longer lose their transaction table because it lacks vertical rules. Wrapped or ambiguous rows remain unsupported; this does not approve transactions or tax facts.

## Where to find it

Use Extract Tables in the PDF toolbox. Scanned borderless tables are outside this change.
